verdict.rationale: Hightouch's hybrid architecture keeps all customer data in the customer's own warehouse/S3 (never copied into Hightouch), and configuration (models, syncs) can be managed via Git Sync and a REST API, which together support avoiding lock-in and taking your data/config elsewhere. However, there's no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export everything' feature or open-format export for audiences/journeys built in the no-code UI. Missing for 10: dedicated data-export documentation, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export of audiences/journeys, and independent confirmation that Git Sync covers all workspace resources.
